title: close saves separate cancel
name: Close saves; Cancel is separate — NN/g
rule: Treat Close as dismiss-and-keep-work and provide a separate Cancel to abandon; when in doubt, save then out.
pass_when: Close (or X-as-close) dismisses and keeps work; a separate Cancel abandons; when in doubt, save then out.
fail_when: One control means both keep and abandon, or Close discards with no separate abandon path.
overview: Close keeps work and dismisses; a separate Cancel abandons changes.
apply_when: Dialogs or editors with both dismiss-and-keep and abandon paths.
not_when: Read-only viewers where dismiss never discards editable work.
agent_hint: Map Close to keep-and-dismiss; give Cancel its own abandon path.
description: Close (or an X treated as close) should dismiss while keeping work; Cancel should abandon. Collapsing both meanings into one control, or letting Close discard with no separate abandon path, causes lost edits and surprise. When unsure, save then exit so dismiss defaults to preserving effort. Apply this where people edit in dialogs or panels; pure read-only viewers with nothing to abandon are out of scope.
